name_ar: المستوى الرابع: اتكلم براحتك في أي موقف
tagline_en: Talk about what might have been, what will be, and the world around you — clearly and confidently.
tagline_ar: اتكلم إنجليزي براحتك في الشغل والسفر والنقاش، من غير ما تقف عند كل جملة.
intro_ar: المستوى ده لكل اللي خلّص المستوى التالت (B1) وعايز ينقل كلامه لمستوى أعلى. في ١٢ أسبوع هتتعلم ٣٦٠ كلمة وتعبير جديد و١٢٠ جملة، وأهم قواعد المستوى المتوسط زي الشرط التالت وwish والأفعال الناقلة والـphrasal verbs. وفي الآخر هتقدر تناقش وتشتكي وتكتب إيميل رسمي ومقال رأي من ١٥٠ لـ٢٠٠ كلمة، وتفهم حلقات BBC وTED-Ed من غير ترجمة.
can_do: After this level you can talk about past decisions and regrets, and imagine how things could have been different.
After this level you can make a complaint politely and firmly, by email or on the phone.
After this level you can report what people said, promised, suggested or denied.
After this level you can make predictions and plans with the future continuous and the future perfect.
After this level you can discuss the news, health, education and global issues, and compare ideas clearly.
After this level you can write emails, reviews, stories and opinion essays of 150–200 words.

end.title: You Finished Level 4! What Next?
end.intro: Congratulations — in 12 weeks you learned 360 new words and expressions, 120 key sentences and the most important intermediate grammar. You can now discuss real topics, write longer texts and follow authentic English. Keep your 30 minutes a day!
next_steps: Go back to the 120 sentences of this level once a week and say them aloud from memory.
Listen to one BBC 6 Minute English episode every day — first without the transcript, then with it.
Watch one TED-Ed lesson a week with English subtitles, and write a 5-line summary of it.
Move to the British Council B2 listening and reading lessons, and try the C1 lessons when they feel easy.
Write one 200-word text a week (email, review or opinion essay) and correct it with the rules from this level.
When you are ready, start Level 5 to reach a confident B2.
end.tip_ar: أنت الآن في مرحلة التحول من «أفهم» إلى «أتكلم براحة». لا تخف من الأخطاء؛ تكلّم كل يوم ولو خمس دقائق، وسجّل صوتك وقارنه بالمتحدثين في الحلقات، وستلاحظ الفرق خلال أسابيع.
